# Panda Federation Tools

> 40 public-data tools in four focused MCP servers: research (8), public funding (10), leads (15) and web security (7). Official or public sources. Pay per result. MIT.

Catalog (source of tool counts): https://pandadad0214.github.io/panda-federation-tools/webmcp-catalog.json

This GitHub Pages site exposes read-only WebMCP tools: list_servers, list_tools, search_tools, get_install_command, get_links, list_editions.

## Install

Needs `APIFY_TOKEN`. Prefer one focused server:

- `uvx --from panda-federation-tools panda-research-tools`
- `uvx --from panda-federation-tools panda-public-funding-tools`
- `uvx --from panda-federation-tools panda-leads-tools`
- `uvx --from panda-federation-tools panda-web-security-tools`
- Umbrella (all 40, or set `PFT_DOMAIN`): `uvx panda-federation-tools`

MCP client config example:

```json
{"mcpServers":{"panda-research-tools":{"command":"uvx","args":["--from","panda-federation-tools","panda-research-tools"],"env":{"APIFY_TOKEN":"${APIFY_TOKEN}"}}}}
```
